features.title: Spacious comfort that supports you all
features.text: With a tall, high-back design, our sofa is made to support your entire upper body. It lets you sit back and share space without sacrificing the full-body comfort each person deserves.

features.title: Ergonomic support where you need it
features.text: Broad armrests are shaped to support your arms naturally, whether you're leaning back or curled up. It’s all about creating a posture-friendly, effortless lounge for everyone.

features.title: Design that flows beautifully
features.text: The waterfall seat edge gives the Aspire its signature curve—adding a soft, inviting look while reducing pressure on your legs. It’s a small detail that makes a big difference.

features.title: Raised to help you keep things clean
features.text: Elevated legs not only make cleaning easier, but also lend the sofa a lighter, more modern profile. It's easy to maintain and lovely to live with—day in and day out.

features.title: Structure you can count on
features.text: Built using solid pine wood and layered with high-density foam (32 kg/m³), our sofa offers reliable strength wrapped in comfort—perfect for gatherings, lounging or simply stretching out.
